reasons.persona_fit: Directly speaks to the owner-operator in Bareni's calm, grounded voice, diagnosing workflow readiness before automating and adhering strictly to the no-CTA brief.
reasons.clarity: Logical and immediately understandable, clearly explaining why data collection discipline must precede AI tools or attribution dashboards.
reasons.actionability: Provides a clear diagnostic question and a feasible, low-friction manual spot-check method tailored to a 1-10 person business.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no unsubstantiated capability claims, respects evidence boundaries, and invents no metrics or customer results.
